scientific_integrity: Exact all-dimensional proof from normalized spherical fourth moments and invariant splitting. Generalized Gram-matrix numerical checker confirms finite test cases. No independent validation or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Theorems concern complex pure degree-two spherical harmonics, continuous function-valued restriction to mutually orthogonal equators with each equator normalized by its own surface probability, and positive scalar weights. No generalization to arbitrary plane orientations, degree bands, finite sampling, noise, or scalar Funk-Radon integrals is established. Historical priority remains provisional because an implicit earlier spectral formula cannot be excluded.
title: Exact quadratic-harmonic frames from orthogonal equatorial traces
